prompt: Please quote samples: Comprehensive MLA Works Cited list
judge_reasoning: Candidate 4 best matches the prompt by providing a concrete “Works Cited” sample list with many (mostly well-known) book entries formatted in a generally MLA-appropriate way, and with fewer highly specific but questionable metadata details. Candidate 1 is the most wide-ranging in source types but includes many very specific citation details across many entries that are harder to verify and some ordering/MLA-precision issues. Candidate 2 offers mostly templates plus a few examples rather than a truly comprehensive sample list, while Candidate 3 is far too short to reasonably qualify as “comprehensive.”
